The ground below features clean, wet cobblestones mirroring the intense golden hues from the ceiling installations, fading into a gentle focal blur in the distance.

backgrounds.name: Marigold Toran Arch
backgrounds.description: Focuses on the lush texture of fresh marigold floral installations paired with delicate micro-LEDs across a grand traditional entrance.
backgrounds.prompt: A straight-on, medium-distance architectural shot framing a massive stone entrance archway decorated for the festival. The entire stone facade is enveloped in dense, cascading curtains of vibrant orange and golden-yellow marigold flowers intertwined with tiny, warm-white fairy lights. Flanking the heavy brass-studded wooden doors are two towering multi-tiered brass standing lamps, each tier holding a ring of glowing wicks. The smooth stone threshold below is clean and polished, catching the golden spill of the festive lights. Intricate floral density, balanced lighting, completely empty of people.

backgrounds.title: Rooftop Lantern Vista
backgrounds.name: Rooftop Lantern Vista
backgrounds.description: Captures a panoramic rooftop terrace glowing with handmade festival paper lanterns and clay lamps overlooking a decorated historic neighborhood.
backgrounds.prompt: A cinematic, wide-angle view across an empty tiled rooftop terrace at deep twilight. Colorful handcrafted paper festival lanterns (kandils) in geometric diamond and star shapes hang from overhead bamboo canopies, glowing softly from within in shades of crimson, saffron, and magenta. The terrace parapet is lined with small burning clay diyas that trace the outer perimeter. Below in the soft-focus distance, the vibrant, blurred glow of festive streetlights illuminates the silhouettes of historic shophouse roofs beneath a clear night sky.

backgrounds.title: Little India Festive Light-Up & Street Archway
backgrounds.name: Little India Festive Light-Up & Street Archway
backgrounds.description: A vibrant, richly illuminated street celebration bathed in radiant neon lights, majestic peacock arches, and the gentle buzz of festive strollers at dusk.
backgrounds.prompt: A wide-angle, cinematic street-level perspective looking down a bustling avenue in Singapore’s Little India at dusk. Towering festive arches adorned with elaborate golden peacock motifs, neon lotus emblems, and thousands of shimmering micro-LED fairy lights stretch overhead toward the vanishing point. The asphalt below catches golden reflections from warm streetlamps and ambient overhead illumination. In the mid-ground and background, soft-focus silhouettes of families and celebrants dressed in vibrant silk saris and kurtas stroll leisurely beneath the glow, admiring the street decor. Gentle traces of fragrant sandalwood incense haze drift through the air, creating a radiant golden-violet twilight bokeh while leaving the wide foreground spacious and softly lit for an interactive portrait.
